name: Is a roof life expectancy assessment different from a general roof inspection?

mainEntity.name: Is a roof life expectancy assessment different from a general roof inspection?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, while both involve inspecting the roof, a life expectancy assessment focuses specifically on estimating the remaining functional lifespan of your roof, often for long-term planning or real estate transactions. A general inspection might be more geared towards identifying immediate repair needs or checking for storm damage. The scope differs, with the life expectancy assessment providing a more predictive outlook.
acceptedAnswer.description: A life expectancy assessment estimates remaining roof life, while a general inspection focuses on immediate repair needs.
